The '''Snow Union I'''  is a {{Special}} Item which was obtained during [[A Honk and Seek Adventure]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Snow Union I''' had a {{Green|1%}} chance to be found from [[Gifts]] during [[A Honk and Seek Adventure]]. Only one can be found per event.

== Usage ==
Trying to place the '''Snow Union I''' like a [[Minion]] on the {{zone|Private Island}} will result in a random message in the player's chat. This can be done even if there are no minion slots available.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Snow Union I''' is a reference to {{Item|Snow Minion I}}.
** Additionally, it also jokes about how [[Minions]] are forced to constantly work for players.
** It could also refer to {{Item|Free Will}}, which grants minions the choice to either abandon their players or stay and work.
